tech.name: Coding-agent session
tech.one_line: One AI model working in a loop with tools: it reads files, edits code, runs commands and checks the result, in your terminal or editor, until the job is done.

predecessor.name: Chatbot (chat assistant), and before it autocomplete: you copy code back and forth

hook.text: Coding agents, 60s: before, you paste your chatbot's code and never stop, but how does 1 agent loop 4 steps until you're done? Here's how, in one story: a mechanic.

claims.text: Chat-based assistants only respond with text you must apply yourself.
One agent works in one loop (gather context, take action, verify results, repeat until done).
The video's 4 steps (read, edit, run, check) are the makers' own words for what the loop does: read your code, edit files, run commands, verify results.
Copilot agent mode reads relevant files, proposes file edits, runs terminal commands and tests, and auto-corrects in a loop until the task is completed.

before.text: A chatbot is the mechanic on the phone. He can only talk. So you paste his fix, run it, and carry the error back to him.

claims.text: Without tools, the model can only respond with text.
Agentic coding is defined as opposed to chat-based assistants that only respond with text you must apply yourself.

new.text: A coding agent is the same mechanic, in your garage, with tools. You give it one job, in your terminal or editor. It reads your files, edits the code, runs a command and checks the result; still broken, it goes around again until the job is done. That's the answer: one agent, one loop, four steps (read, edit, run, check). The whole visit is one session.

claims.text: The agentic loop: gather context, take action, verify results, repeat until done; tools read your code, edit files, run commands.
Claude Code runs in the terminal, IDE extensions, the desktop app and the web; the agentic loop is identical everywhere.
A session is a conversation tied to your current directory; each message, tool use and result is written to its transcript.
Codex CLI: inspect files, make edits, and run the tools already installed on your machine; one focused terminal loop.
Copilot agent mode auto-corrects in a loop until the task is completed.

why.text: You stop being the messenger. You watch, and you can stop it at any moment.

claims.text: The AI reads files, runs commands and makes changes while you watch, redirect, or step away.
You can interrupt the loop at any point to steer it.

takeaway.text: It can still be wrong, so give it a test to run. The mechanic did not get a bigger brain: he got hands (tools) and a way to check his own work.

claims.text: The agentic loop is powered by models that reason and tools that act; the harness provides the tools.
Verification loop: without a check it can run, the agent may accept a result that only looks plausible; with one, it iterates until the check passes.

outro.text: Spoken call to action: subscribe for the next one. On screen: a Subscribe button and 'Next in 60 seconds: what are Agent Skills?'
